'''2020 TMW Pods Bastian Winkelhaus LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open They Have No Idea We're Comi Winkel.txt |Download]]
